name: af3_torch_predict
description: Predict the all-atom structure of a biomolecular complex with AF3-torch (the xfold PyTorch port of AlphaFold 3, running the public OpenFold3-preview2 parameters). Input is an AlphaFold 3 fold-input JSON (dialect 'alphafold3'), and every chain must carry its own MSAs inline: no genetic-database search is run. Returns the paths of the predicted mmCIF files and their confidence and ranking scores; the mmCIF text itself only when return_structures is true.

name.description: A job name used for the output file names (default 'fold'). Letters, digits, '-' and '_'.

return_structures.description: Return the mmCIF text of the best-ranked model (default false: it is megabytes for a real complex, and the transport truncates a reply at 100,000 characters). Paths and scores come back either way.
